$comment: Source of truth for CD change-detection. Consumed by
Each component names the paths whose changes require it to be rebuilt, and
the git marker tag recording the commit it was last built from. A nightly
run diffs marker..HEAD; an empty diff means the component is skipped.
'cascades' lists components that must also rebuild when this one does.
The addon is compiled into the server images and the daemon bundle (all of
src/app, src/core/server and src/core/daemon depend on
@checkpointvcs/longtail-addon), so publishing a new addon forces both.

vscode.description: checkpoint-vscode extension (.vsix, VS Code Marketplace + Open VSX)
$comment: Separate from 'client' so a VS Code-only change does not rebuild the
four-OS installer matrix, and a CLI-only change does not republish the
extension. It still shares client_version: set-version.js stamps
The longtail addon deliberately does NOT cascade here. The extension
imports FileStatus/FileType and the AppRouter type from the daemon and
esbuild bundles them, but nothing in that graph reaches the native
addon, so a new addon changes nothing about the .vsix.

client.description: Desktop installers, headless CLI packages, daemon, tray
